sources_read: rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx: Quality Checks row 48 and Internal Quality Checks row 48 (identical wording, no cell comment)
rules/projects/webdev-task-template/tests/app_context.md and the five template prompt.md files
task/tests/test.sh (app_context substitution, restart helper export), task/tests/Dockerfile (playwright-mcp pin)
task/solution/app/src/app.tsx, src/style.css, server.js (grep for control labels, dialogs, routes)
evidence:
No residue from other work was found. All five prompts open with 'Evaluate the live Colderwater playground at http://localhost:3000 using Playwright MCP' and contain {app_context} and {criteria}. A case-insensitive search of tests/app_context.md, the five prompt.md files, the five judge.toml files, instruction.md, the six notes and task.toml for sign-in, tenant, password, forged, role, admin, login, hireops, CHANGE_ME, TODO and the misspelling 'coldwater' returned only the three intended no-sign-in statements (app_context.md:10 'None. The app has no sign-in; every browser tab or context uses the same shared library.', instruction.md:5, policy.md:3, overview.md:3). The template's sign-in, forged-request, tenant-isolation and 'persistence criterion is last' text is absent from the task's prompts. The product name is spelled Colderwater everywhere and every criterion id carries the cw_ prefix.

App facts agree with the public notes: app_context.md:6 'local JavaScript and HTML code playground: a custom code editor, a preview, a console and a shared library of saved snippets with revision history. The filename ending (.js or .html) chooses how Run executes the source' matches overview.md:3; app_context.md:14 key screen list (title and filename fields, Undo, Redo, Format, Find, Replace, line and column readout, Run, Stop, New, Save, preview, console, library, history) matches ui.md:5,9,11,15,17; app_context.md:24 health address matches integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health'; app_context.md:30 'may be restored as a static picture' matches behaviour.md:5 'A restored picture may be static'.

Cross-references between prompts, context and criteria resolve: constraints/prompt.md:5 'two hard requirements' and 'the second criterion' match the two criteria in file order (cw_custom_document_surface, cw_shared_saved_record); functional/prompt.md:20 'the three uses named in the application notes' matches app_context.md:26 'exactly three things', and each use has exactly one kind of consumer (storage clearing in cw_shared_saved_record and cw_save_reload_restart, replay in cw_history_restore_retry, the localStorage entry in cw_preview_isolation); functional/prompt.md:31 'Only the criterion that names it may call the restart_app tool' has exactly one consumer (cw_save_reload_restart) and the verifier MCP server is declared only in functional/judge.toml:14-18; app_context.md:24 'One criterion also uses a public https address' has exactly one consumer (cw_preview_isolation). The polish prompt's scope line ('keyboard access, focus, feedback and narrow screens') matches its six criteria and none of them needs a script exception. The visual prompt's 0 to 5 rule matches the anchors in all three likert criteria. Criterion counts are 1, 2, 42, 6 and 3; task.toml quotes no count.

The scripted golden results on these bytes (hashes verified) show the golden has the screens and controls the context names; that is not a configured judge run, and none exists for these bytes.

Three minor observations, none of which I could turn into a demonstrated wrong grade:
(a) app_context.md:18 states as fact 'The editor is the app's own surface, not a form field.' and 'Read the current source from the rendered editor lines'. This text is injected into gates/constraints, whose first criterion decides exactly that question. For a submission built on a textarea the context sentence is untrue and tells the judge the conclusion before it inspects the DOM. The criterion's own fail conditions are explicit, so I rate this latent, but it is unmeasured on a weak app with the configured judge.
(b) scored/visual/prompt.md:12 tells the judge to select a word with a double click, 'watch the caret for about two seconds', and 'take your screenshots with that selection in place', while cw_visual_editor_readability scores 'the visibility of the caret and of a selection' with 5 meaning 'caret and selection easy to see'. An editor that hides its caret while a range is selected, as native text fields do, would be screenshotted with no caret. The brief does not say whether a caret is shown during a selection.
(c) app_context.md:24-27 notes about the public https address, the preview-isolation localStorage entry, replay and the restart tool are injected into all five dimensions although only the functional dimension has those criteria and that tool. Each note is worded 'where a criterion asks', so it is inert elsewhere.
counterexample: None demonstrated. Latent only: (a) a submission whose visible source lives in a transparent textarea over a highlighted copy is graded by a judge that has just read 'The editor is the app's own surface, not a form field' as an application fact; (b) a conforming editor that hides the caret during a range selection could lose a point on cw_visual_editor_readability because the prompt fixes a selection in place for the screenshots.
suggested_fix: Optional. (a) Reword app_context.md:18 to 'The editor is expected to be the app's own surface rather than a form field; the constraints dimension checks this.' (b) In scored/visual/prompt.md:12 have the judge watch and screenshot the caret before making the selection, then screenshot the selection separately.
